title: Airfare Markets Under Pressure
tldr: Explore how competition and hub dominance shape U.S. airfares using interactive visualizations of 2022–2025 flight data and predictive models that forecast future ticket prices

title: STA314 Kaggle Competition
tldr: Ranked 1st/69 teams. Designed an end-to-end ML pipeline using feature engineering, VRM data augmentation, and ensemble tree-based models to extract signal from noisy, high-variance data.

title: Market Map: Your First Job Market Visualization
tldr: MarketMap equips upcoming graduates with demographic trends and company benefit data—packed into clear, interactive visualizations—to help students confidently navigate early-career moves.

title: Lakers Analysis: A Creative Visualization of Lakers
tldr: Experience the LA Lakers' 2024-2025 season through an interactive data visualization that transcends traditional charts, combining advanced game metrics with dynamic visual storytelling.

title: Factors Influencing Statistics' Students Engagement in Extracurricular Activities
tldr: Using Simple Random Sampling proportion tests, chi-square tests, and logistic regression, the study evaluates how factors like work status, study habits, and supportiveness impact participation.

title: Predicting IMDB Movies Gross Revenue Using Multiple Linear Regression
tldr: A multiple linear regression model to predict movie gross revenue by analyzing key drivers such as genre, ratings, and budget. The project also explores Box-Cox transformation, F- and t-tests, VIF, and Cook's Distance.

title: The Island Simulation: method of canopy consumption and gender on IQ
tldr: This project investigates whether cannabis consumption methods and gender affect changes in IQ. Using data from The Islands virtual population simulator, it applies a Repeated-Measures Two-Way ANOVA to evaluate their impact over time.
